W/Con/348/3rd/4th Line/GDK-GJH/CALA] अभय कुमार गुप् ता , मुख्य प्र िासजिक अजधकारी/जिमााण MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS [North Eastern Railway (Construction Organization)] NOTIFICATION Gorakhpur, the 4th May, 2026 S.O. 2202(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by Clause 7(A) of Section 2 of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (Act No. 11 of 2008),the Central Government hereby authorizes the officers mentioned in column (2) of the table below as “Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA)” to perform the function as such authority under the said Act with effect from the date of publication of this notification in the official Gazette in respect of Special Railway Project of “Gonda Kacheri to Goldinganj 3rd& 4th Line” in the states mentioned in column (4) and districts mentioned in column (3) of the said table for the public purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of such Special Railway Project.
